requirements.description: Preserve existing public behavior covered by project tests

Export mergeRanges(ranges) from src/ranges.mjs. Input is an array of [start,end] finite number pairs with start <= end. Return sorted merged ranges: overlapping or touching ranges merge. Empty input returns []. Do not mutate the input or share output pair arrays with it. Invalid pairs, reversed endpoints or nonfinite numbers throw TypeError.

Export resolveOptions(base,override) from src/options.mjs. For own enumerable string keys, shallow-merge override into base, except undefined override values keep base values; undefined keys absent from base are omitted. Preserve null, false, zero and empty string as explicit values. Return a new object; never mutate inputs. Inherited keys must be ignored. Both inputs are plain objects. Special key names such as "__proto__" must still become own enumerable properties of the result (ordinary assignment is not enough; use Object.defineProperty for own keys when needed).

Export csvRow(values) from src/format.mjs. Accept an array of strings and return one CSV row without a trailing newline. Separate cells with commas. Quote cells containing comma, double quote, CR or LF; double each embedded double quote. Preserve whitespace, Unicode and empty cells exactly. Empty array returns empty string. Do not mutate values.

Export splitCents(total,count) from src/shares.mjs. total must be a nonnegative safe integer, count a positive safe integer <= 1000; throw RangeError otherwise. Return count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one. Extra cents go to earliest indices. No floating point rounding of fractional shares.

Export pageAfter(items,cursor,limit) from src/page.mjs. items is an array of objects with unique string id. Preserve input order. cursor=null starts at first item; a known cursor starts immediately after its item; an unknown cursor throws RangeError. limit must be integer 1..100 or throw RangeError. Return {items: page, nextCursor}: nextCursor is last returned id only if more items remain, otherwise null. Do not mutate inputs.
